answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake locked for a long vesting period, like a ship tied at a jetty in a harbor: the stake only earns trust after the identity shows a steady pulse of useful, verified work over weeks. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of locked stakes, and one bad act forfeits the stake, so the attacker pays real money for every fake face while honest agents keep their deposit.
